lockFileMaintenance.description: Only mechanism that updates transitive dependencies absent from every package.json. Do not delete the empty schedule: Renovate's built-in default for this block is ['before 4am on monday'], so removing the key restores a four-hour weekly window instead of removing the restriction. A repository schedule cannot start a Renovate run — isScheduledNow() only filters a run that is already in progress — so any window is a bet that Mend's scheduler happens to land inside it. That bet lost every week between 2026-06-08 and 2026-08-14. An empty schedule always passes the check, and costs no extra PR noise because lockFileMaintenance maintains a single branch.

description: Automerge is off by default and opted into per rule, so every rule that wants it has to say so.
automergeType `pr` keeps the PR, and with it the CI run, mandatory.

internalChecksFilter is strict, so Renovate filters release candidates by minimumReleaseAge. It proposes the newest release that is old enough, or nothing, and lists the young release under Pending Status Checks on the Dependency Dashboard.
GitHub runner images are exempt from minimumReleaseAge because their datasource provides no release timestamps. Their updates require manual review.

platformAutomerge is off as a second guard. GitHub's automerge is armed at PR creation and weighs only the required checks, so it would merge past a pending `renovate/stability-days` check if a young release ever reached a branch. Renovate's own automerge waits for CI to pass *and* for its internal checks, and merges at its next run.
Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts defaults set minimumReleaseAge to null, so security fixes are not delayed by it.
The last package rule labels the PRs that Renovate will merge automatically.

customManagers.description: Update the JMX exporter version and its SHA-256 in the same PR.

packageRules.description: Prioritise lock file maintenance so it does not lose the last concurrency slot to routine bumps

Automerge npm lock maintenance after CI. Workaround for https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/issues/45236: lock-file maintenance has no release timestamp, so Renovate’s branch check otherwise stays pending forever. The three-day delay is enforced during dependency resolution by minimumReleaseAge: 4320 in every pnpm-workspace.yaml, including transitive dependencies.
Create minor updates only while fewer than 6 PRs are open, leaving the remaining slots to patch updates.
Create major updates and package replacements last and only while fewer than 2 PRs are open.
Disable digest updates by default
Update the Koski and OmaData OAuth2 sample base images when their tag is rebuilt

Renovate loses the image timestamp before its PR stability check, leaving digest updates blocked forever (https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/issues/45236). Allow the missing timestamp only for these versioned Docker Hub tags after matchCurrentAge confirms they are at least three days old. Keep matchCurrentAge aligned with minimumReleaseAge.
Automerge the development and test database images
Automerge GitHub Actions minor and patch updates as one PR. Deploy and notification actions require manual review.
Raise runner image updates on their own. The github-runners datasource has no release dates, so the strict internalChecksFilter would hold these back forever unless minimumReleaseAge is lifted.
Separate minor and patch npm updates
Group patch npm updates
Automerge devDependency patch updates
Group all Parcel updates together. Placed after the npm patch groups so that their groupName does not override this one.
Pin direct npm dependencies
Use the same Node releases for Renovate's constraint and .nvmrc pins
Update Node.js pins and Renovate's tool constraint together
Automerge Node and Corretto base-image digest updates after CI.
Use Node LTS versioning for @types/node so its major updates follow the same stability policy as the runtime, rather than npm's latest tag.
Group @types/node major updates with the Node runtime for manual review. Minor and patch versions do not track the runtime's versions, so they stay on the ordinary npm rules.
Update the shared pnpm toolchain together. Automerge minor and patch updates.
pnpm majors can change the lockfile format and defaults; review them manually.
Update Koski's Playwright package and visual test image together
fs2 minor updates need Hotswap->NonEmptyHotswap refactoring
mockito-core update breaks RichRequest mocking
Propose Maven patch updates separately from minor ones, so that a minor that breaks does not hold back the patch. Minor updates are not grouped either: one that breaks would block the rest.

openhtmltopdf and its pdfbox backend render the certificate PDFs, and even patch releases have changed their visual output. Keep them in their own PR, patches included, so that a layout regression does not hold back unrelated updates. Updating them together also keeps openhtmltopdf-pdfbox on a pdfbox it was built against. Automerge is safe because TodistusLatausSpec compares rendered regions against reference images pixel by pixel.
Automerge Maven test-scope dependencies after CI. Scalatra's test kit shares scalatra.version with the runtime Scalatra artifacts, so it stays in their PR.
Automerge Maven build plugins that the PR build runs. The PR build never packages the WAR.

The Maven patch groups below take only updates that no earlier rule has grouped, so monorepo groups such as the AWS SDK and fs2 stay intact. Test and build groups come first so that the runtime group does not claim their updates.
Group Maven build plugin patch updates
Group the remaining Maven patch updates
Pin postgres Docker image to match RDS version (RDS upgrades to 15.17 on 2026-06-03; auto-minor-version-upgrade is enabled in RDS). Bump this constraint when RDS is upgraded further.
Stay on Scala 2.13
Skip http4s 1.0 milestone builds
Stay on OpenSearch 1
Stay on mockito-core 2
Keep Koski UI on React 16
Schema viewer library updates require manual review and must not join unrelated npm groups.
Label PRs that Renovate will merge automatically and exempt them from the PR limits. This must be the last rule, so that it sees the automerge value set by the rules above.
